name: @foss-earth/browser-testing
description: Shared Node browser lifecycle, interception, screenshot review and bounded evidence helpers for development tests.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2023 --skipLibCheck false fixtures/types/public-consumer.ts
scripts.ci: npm run check:source && npm run typecheck && npm test

fossEarthBrowserTools.scope: Development/test only; no automatic browser/tool acquisition or application runtime dependency
fossEarthBrowserTools.qualification: Reviewed six-commit human ancestry attached; candidate package and browser qualification pending; coordinator owns publication
